insight: Raised a $12M seed in 2025 led by Point72 Ventures (Qualcomm and Samsung joined); founder Bill Zhu led Meta's Applied RL team.
name: Pokee AI
tagline: RL-powered agent that runs workflows across your apps and tools.
description: Pokee AI is an agent platform that plans, reasons, and executes multi-step tasks across your software stack from natural-language instructions. It connects via one-click OAuth to 90+ integrations (Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Jira, GitHub, Salesforce, plus social platforms) and thousands of tools. It is built on proprietary reinforcement learning for tool selection rather than hand-built workflows, and can run hosted or fully inside your own network.
edge: Leans on reinforcement learning (a claimed ~97% tool-selection accuracy) to route multi-step tasks across thousands of tools without predefined flows.
pros: Free tier plus low-cost paid plans
Plans multi-step tasks from plain English
Runs hosted or fully in your network
